description: Surfaces the compliance signals that matter before they are asked — fair-lending disparities, disclosure-timing exposure, and dissatisfaction clusters that may be unlogged complaints — correlated across the core, origination, and the contact center.

Answers the deep compliance query in plain language — counting members and products by characteristic across the core, origination, and the contact center — and reconciles them into one traceable population.

Flags the outliers: an approval-rate gap by age, a Loan Estimate delivered late, a missing ESIGN consent, and a dissatisfaction phrase that meets the CFPB complaint definition — each with its regulatory citation.
Generates the member-specific disclosure checklist and calendar, placing each disclosure on its required date under the rules and flagging past-due and at-risk items.
Forecasts exam and audit exposure and directs limited resources to the files and patterns most likely to become findings, separating file-level fixes from pattern-level analysis.

Maps where the compliance process and the member journey break — late disclosures, missing consent, files that stepped outside procedure, and attrition that shows up as withdrawn applications and named competitors.
Assembles the exam-ready evidence package — population, tests and citations, disclosure remediation, fair-lending analysis, and logged complaints — every figure traceable to its source system.
